violations.why: disable_isr(1) masks only willow; kestrel (priority 2) can still preempt between the check and the reset, so the reset acts on a stale value.
Kestrel can run after the write in fn_tundra, during init() or before/after the disable, and change the value before the task reads it.
Willow is not yet masked between line 26 and line 16, so it can modify the value before the task reads it.
Higher-priority kestrel can preempt willow's non-atomic increment, and the decrement is then lost.
